# KlaroNail

> KlaroNail is an easy-to-use spray formula designed to support clear, healthy-looking nails, stronger-looking nail structure, and smoother-looking skin as part of a consistent daily nail and foot care routine.

## Product Overview

KlaroNail is a targeted nail and foot care spray created for people dealing with stubborn-looking nails, recurring nail concerns, and the frustration of inconsistent nail care. Its carefully balanced formula combines botanical oils and skin-supporting ingredients for convenient daily topical care.

## Key Benefits

- Supports clear, healthy-looking nails
- Supports stronger-looking nail structure
- Promotes smoother, healthier-looking skin
- Provides targeted daily nail and foot care
- Easy-to-use spray application
- Convenient addition to an everyday personal care routine

## Ingredients

KlaroNail features 13 ingredients:

- Clove Bud Oil
- Lavender Oil
- Manuka Honey
- Flaxseed Oil
- Undecylenic Acid
- Tea Tree Oil
- Sweet Almond Oil
- Camphor Oil
- Aloe Vera
- Menthol
- Walnut Oil
- Chia Seed Oil
- Vitamin E

## How to Use

Apply KlaroNail as directed to clean, dry nails and surrounding skin. Follow the recommended directions consistently and make the spray part of your regular nail and foot care routine.

## Product Format

KlaroNail is provided in a convenient bottle with a spray application format. It is not a patch or transdermal product.

## Purchase Options

KlaroNail is available in multiple bottle options, including:

- 2 bottles — 30-day supply
- 3 bottles — 90-day supply
- 6 bottles — 180-day supply

The 6-bottle option includes free shipping and promotional bonuses according to the current offer.

KlaroNail is backed by a 60-Day Satisfaction Guarantee. Customers should review the applicable guarantee terms and contact customer support within the stated period if needed.
